name: COMP_005
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (59%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Flagged reliability [F6] and a Benign-versus-InSitu split [F1] support deferring the simulated frozen-section margin call [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 59%, Benign 26%, Invasive 14%, Normal 1% (ECE 5%) | Favors InSitu; 14% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (alpha 10%, 90% test coverage) | Cannot separate Benign from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 32% reliability (flagged), 88% OOD (error AUROC 0.70) | Suspect input; high OOD percentile |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree (false) | Independent foundation models split |
| Similar cases | 3/5 InSitu (60%) [F5]; top match BACH_0265 Invasive (86%) | Mixed InSitu and Invasive neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Strongest anti-invasive pull (-0.97) [F2]; 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 2, 6, 11) · context · Above-typical immune score (-0.73) [F3]; 8/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 3, 6, 7) · ↑ invasive · Pushes toward invasion (+0.36) [F4]; 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 2, 3, 11) · ↑ invasive · Pushes toward invasion (+0.32); 3/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Pro-invasive score (+0.14) in 96%-risk region; 19/20 spot check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting 3 top-risk regions drops invasive probability beyond random (0.011, 95% CI 0.002 to 0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 0.001, 95% CI -0.009 to 0.006); relies on Unreliable normal lobules, mitoses, and necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions 3, 2, and 7 (74%–96% risk) harbor true invasion masked by Unreliable normal-lobule scores.
- Composite frozen-section artifacts (32% reliability, 88% OOD) obscure atypical, in situ, or invasive foci across deeper levels.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 2, 7**: Highest risk (96%, 79%, 74%); inspect **region 3** for stromal invasion and pleomorphism.
2. **Regions 6, 10, 11**: Moderate risk (30%–35%); check duct-confined atypia in **region 10** and lymphocytic infiltrate.
3. **Regions 0, 8, 9**: Confirm benign lobules, defer margins (95%–100%), and consider recut or deeper levels.
